verdict.rationale: Jan ships its own local OpenAI-compatible API server at localhost:1337. The documented endpoints are GET /v1/models, POST /v1/chat/completions (streaming, tool calling) and POST /v1/messages (Anthropic-compatible), so core inference is reachable programmatically. Much of what the UI does is documented only as UI actions, with no API equivalents shown: Hub search and download, GGUF import, creating assistants, assigning assistants to projects, MCP configuration and tool approval, and settings. Missing for 10: API endpoints for model download/import and management, assistant/project/thread management, MCP and settings control, any documented UI-API parity claim, and an OpenAPI spec (probes 404).
